title: Workload Replay Orchestrator for Dedicated Throughput SLAs
creator: Connor Reyes
description: Build an orchestrator and test kit that validates Dedicated capacity throughput guarantees against customer-like traffic. The orchestrator must be able to: 1) replay sanitized customer traces, 2) synthesize hybrid traffic profiles (mix of small chat requests, long generation, and embedding queries), 3) simulate autoscaling events and capacity preemption, 4) measure tail latencies (p95/p99/p999), throughput per-GPU and per-pool, and 5) produce customer-facing acceptance reports. This ticket covers design, instrumented harness, integration with the current load lab, standard metrics export (Prometheus/OTel), and a templated acceptance test that solutions/sales can run with customers during Dedicated onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can replay at least three anonymized customer traces with configurable rps, payload mix, and KV cache hit-rate simulation
Synthetic profile generator supports at least: chat_short (<=64 tokens), chat_long (>=512 tokens), embeddings, and reranking flows
Automated autoscale injector can trigger scale-up and scale-down events and report impact on throughput and tail latency
Standardized report generated per-run with p50/p95/p99/p999, throughput, errors, cache-hit rate, and resource utilization (GPU/mem) exported as a single artifact
Acceptance template includes pass/fail thresholds for throughput SLA, tail latency SLO, error rate, and warm-start recovery time
Integrations exist for dashboards (Grafana link placeholders) and a generated GitHub PR with test run artifacts for auditing
test_plan: Phase 1: Integration smoke runs in staging fleet using small footprint (2 node pool) with replayed trace A and synthetic profile B. Phase 2: Scale-up stress with 10–50 node pools, introduce autoscale events and preemption scenarios, measure steady-state and transient behavior. Phase 3: Customer acceptance run using sanitized customer trace + templated report; run with SE and solutions engineer present. Each run includes warmup (5 minutes), measurement window (10 minutes), and cooldown (3 minutes). Collect token-level latency buckets and per-request metadata for post-run analysis.
orchestrator_design_notes: Core: pluggable workload adapters (trace-replay adapter, synthetic profile adapter, embedding adapter)
Traffic shaping: allow poisson, bursty, and closed-loop rate control to mimic backpressure-sensitive clients
KV cache simulation: support configurable prefix reuse, hit ratio targets, and cold-warm transitions
Autoscale simulation: implement network-level throttles and API-level scale triggers to validate routing/fallback behavior
Observability: emit OTel spans and Prometheus metrics; include per-request tags for model_variant, pool_id, and run_id
progress_updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with Product and Solutions; aligned on customer acceptance artifacts and required fields

2025-03-02: Autoscale injector prototype can trigger scale events via control-plane and simulate preemption; observed expected transient p99 spikes in staging
2025-03-05: Integrations with Grafana templated; beginning template for customer-facing acceptance report
